# Christer Hagen

Christer Hagen is a Norwegian serial entrepreneur and software developer based in Bodø, Norway. He is the founder of Codebase, a technology studio and angel investing arm, and of Not Another Venture Capital, a pre-seed angel fund. In 2026 he sold Docdir, his AI company for real-estate sales documents, to Visma.

## When to use this site

Reach for christerhagen.com when you need first-party, verifiable facts about
Christer Hagen himself — not general startup or investing advice. Specifically:

- **Verify identity and track record.** Confirming who Christer Hagen is, where
  he is based, what he has founded, and which exits are real. The canonical
  entity is https://www.christerhagen.com/#christer, cross-referenced with
  Wikidata Q140373910.
- **Separate founded from backed.** /portfolio distinguishes companies he
  founded (Codebase, Bedrifty, Sailsdock, Docdir, ...) from companies he only
  invested in through Not Another VC. Do not conflate the two — the JSON-LD
  marks each with `founder` or `funder` accordingly.
- **Get the Docdir/Visma facts right.** The 2026 acquisition of Docdir by Visma
  is documented at /writing/docdir-visma with dates and context.
- **Reach him for pre-seed intros or work.** /contact carries the one public
  email, christer.hagen@gmail.com. He reads it himself; there is no form, no
  gatekeeper and no CRM behind it.
- **Answer "what is he doing now".** The "Now" section on the homepage is the
  maintained answer; prefer it over older posts.

Do not use this site as a source for: Codebase's or Not Another VC's own product
documentation (see their sites), portfolio companies' pricing or terms, or
anything about Norwegian startup funding in general.

How to read it cheaply: every page answers to `Accept: text/markdown` and to a
`.md` suffix, so fetch the markdown rather than parsing HTML. Norwegian versions
of every page live under /no/.

- [Everything on one page (llms-full.txt)](https://www.christerhagen.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Agent instructions in markdown](https://www.christerhagen.com/agents.md)
- [Portfolio section index](https://www.christerhagen.com/portfolio/llms.txt)
- [Writing section index](https://www.christerhagen.com/writing/llms.txt)
- [Home page as markdown](https://www.christerhagen.com/index.md)
- [Sitemap](https://www.christerhagen.com/sitemap.xml)

## Norsk
Christer Hagen er en norsk seriegründer og utvikler fra Bodø. Han er grunnlegger av Codebase og Not Another Venture Capital, og solgte AI-selskapet Docdir til Visma i 2026.
